description: This is a platform upgrade script for certain embedded devices, containing functions for identifying firmware images, checking images, and performing upgrade procedures specific to NAND flash and other formats. It includes device-specific logic for different hardware models and image formats.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a given byte offset and outputs as a hex string

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 4-byte long at a specific offset in a file

methods.name: platform_flash_type
methods.description: Determines if the device uses serial or NAND flash based on /proc/mtd content

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns expected firmware image name based on device model

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies firmware format and extracts relevant info from the image

methods.name: platform_other_check_image
methods.description: Performs validation on the firmware image, including format and device match checks

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Main entry point for checking if the firmware image is suitable for upgrade

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_trx
methods.description: Handles upgrading from a TRX firmware image on NAND devices

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_seamaseal
methods.description: Handles upgrading NAND devices using a Seama seal image

methods.name: platform_img_from_safeloader
methods.description: Extracts image files from a SafeLoader firmware image

methods.name: platform_other_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade steps based on identified firmware format

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point for performing the firmware upgrade process
